dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep convex anterior margin relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical pixel height.
